callers.runtime_output: Captured in process memory; plaintext credentials must not be logged or exported.

preservation: Existing issuer, schemas, registry and database transaction semantics are unchanged
Existing identities, TEST history, encrypted state and scoped finite credentials are retained
Maintenance retains existing same-scope renewal and reload behavior
No default human password, service browser login, broad token or alternate identity platform
Normal ingestion and Brain submission OFF; LIVE_REAL DISABLED
No strategy, source logger, Library, ledger or unrelated service changes
acceptance: Exact installed file hashes, private real-software tests, actual website-only restart and canonical health/readback are required in the adoption receipt. A source contract alone does not prove deployment.
scope_boundary: Physical facts registration and separate dormant operational enrollment require independently verified owner evidence and exact operator authorization. This caller contract grants neither activation nor human approval.
